page.overview:
Who is Baudros?

Baudros, the Dragon formerly known as "Splinterwing," is a two-headed Chaos Dragon abomination mutated by the raw powers of Chaos. Baudros currently serves as the partner and flying steed of Egrimm van Horstmann, Champion of Tzeentch. This massive draconic monstrosity is bloated and warped beyond recognition; with folds of black-grey scaled flesh bulging over the tops of its legs, a crooked back ridged with plates of bone, and a thick tail more akin to a deadly spiky club.

One head is bestial; with a brutal under-shot jaw full of upwards-jutting fangs and tiny red eyes buried in ridges of bone. The other head is clever; its frame long and slender, a greenish tongue that lashes like a caged snake, and with eyes that are sharp as steel. With one head spouting out black fire, and the other spewing out acidic bile, Baudros is destruction incarnate, leaving naught but ruin in its wake.

During the time of the Emperor Magnus the Pious in the 24th century IC, Baudros was awoken from his slumber by the foul winds blowing south during the Great War Against Chaos. He was a threat to all of the Empire, bringing devastation and spreading the foul taint of Chaos. It was only by the efforts of the High Elf archmage Teclis, one of the most powerful wizards the world has ever known, that Baudros was defeated.

However, not even he could finish off the beast, so with no other option, Teclis imprisoned the Chaos Dragon in a magical chamber buried beneath the ground, which eventually became the location of the College of Light in Altdorf. The greatest defence against the release of Baurdos was that no mortal knew about the beast's whereabouts...no mortal except Egrimm van Horstmann.
